about: Handguns of Skyrim firearms (wall-buys and the Coffer) plus spell tomes and grimoires (Coffer only). Damage in design units. projectile: tracer each shot (sheet: projectiles) for guns; tomes use their spell.

rows.label: Grave Spark
rows.abilityText: Fast arcane bolts. Charged: a held beam of force that pierces the line.
rows.chargeText: A beam of raw force tears through the whole line

rows.label: Plague Bolt
rows.abilityText: Plague bolts. The rot spreads when they drop.
rows.chargeText: A green plague-cloud swallows the crowd

rows.label: Soulwisp
rows.abilityText: Wisps that seek the dead. Charged: six wisps hunt down a crowd.
rows.chargeText: Five souls ripped out at once

rows.label: Bramble Spike
rows.abilityText: A spray of poison thorns. Charged: roots burst up and hold the dead in place.
rows.chargeText: Thorns erupt and lock the horde in place

rows.label: Bloodreaver
rows.abilityText: Drain bolts that heal you. Charged: a blood nova round you that feeds on every foe it hits.
rows.chargeText: Drain every foe around you dry

rows.label: Bone Spear
rows.chargeText: A wall of bone traps everything ahead

rows.label: Moonshard
rows.chargeText: A moonbeam splits the night in two

rows.label: Hexfire
rows.chargeText: Mark the horde. They explode in a chain

rows.label: Mind Spike
rows.chargeText: The dead turn on each other

rows.label: Voidcall
rows.abilityText: A slow void orb that drags the dead in. Charged: a black hole that pulls them together and collapses.
rows.chargeText: A singularity swallows the horde

rows.label: Starfall
rows.chargeText: Six stars crash down around your mark

rows.label: Dawnlight
rows.abilityText: Holy light that sears the undead. Charged: a sunburst that blinds and burns a wide circle.
rows.chargeText: A sunburst scorches everything near

rows.label: Emberbrand
rows.abilityText: Fire bolts that set the dead alight. Charged: a lobbed fireball that bursts and burns.
rows.chargeText: Call a meteor down on your mark

rows.label: Cryo Freeze
rows.abilityText: An ice beam that freezes a foe solid for 5 seconds. Charged: a nova that freezes everything near.
rows.chargeText: Freeze the whole crowd solid

rows.label: Stormcaller
rows.abilityText: Lightning that leaps between the dead. Charged: a thunderbolt called down from the sky.
rows.chargeText: Lightning tears through ten of them

rows.label: Gale
rows.abilityText: A gust that cuts down three or four of the dead. Charged: a wind ball that bursts and flings them far.
rows.chargeText: A spray of wind arrows knocks them all flat

rows.label: Wabbajack
rows.chargeText: Madness takes every foe nearby

rows.label: Grimoire of the Thu'um
rows.chargeText: The full shout. Everything flies

rows.label: Sky Sunder
rows.chargeText: Lightning leaps through twelve foes

rows.label: Apprentice's Tome
rows.chargeText: A beam through everything in the line

rows.label: Giant's Hearth
rows.abilityText: Ember bolts burst where they land.
rows.chargeText: Six meteors rain down around you

rows.label: Gildergreen Bough
rows.chargeText: Living wood binds them. You heal whole

rows.label: Heart of Lorkhan
rows.chargeText: Time stops. Then they shatter

rows.label: Arkay's Last Rite
rows.chargeText: Arkay's judgement strikes every undead near

rows.label: Hjaalmarch Mirestaff
rows.chargeText: A bog drags them under

rows.label: Eye of Magnus
rows.chargeText: Three crystal eyes burn the dead for eight seconds

rows.label: Wolf Queen's Longbow
rows.chargeText: Nine arrows. Every one hit fights for you

rows.label: Ysgramor's Stormbow
rows.chargeText: A blizzard of ice and lightning on twelve

rows.label: Nightingale's Shadowbow
rows.chargeText: Mark all in sight. Each death takes the next

rows.label: Vaermina's Dreamstring
rows.chargeText: Ten burning stars fall from the sky

balance: Damage is in BO3 units against round health (rounds.hpStart 400 at night 1, ~1500 by night 10, ~2200 by night 30). Box staves ~330-420 per shot (0.75 s): one body shot at night 1, ~4 at night 10, ~5-6 at night 30; headshots x2. Reforge +50%/level (x2.5 at level 3, which also makes the signature move Ascendant: x1.25, 25% shorter cooldown, an echo at 75%). City relics ~1.6x the box. Against Skyrim's own enemies every hit is scaled by the player's level (0.5x at 1, 1x at 25, 1.5x at 50).
